Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: recreation.gov: $21 a night ($42 for a double site) in 2026 and 2027; the Forest Service's 2026 table says $23. One RV with its tow vehicle per site; an extra vehicle pays a nightly fee at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234596/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01 and 2027-05-20 to 2027-10-01: 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC' 21, 'STANDARD NONELECTRIC-DOUBLE' 42) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Cow Creek South CG '$23') + recreation.gov notice ('Extra vehicle will be charged a per night fee and collected at the campground'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov catalogues 43 reservable sites (2 pull-through), most listed for 40-ft vehicles; its description says 44, and the Forest Service's 2026 table says 32 sites, longest 30 ft.

sites.source: recreation.gov catalog for 234596 (43 sites, all reservable; Driveway Entry Back-In 41, Pull-Through 2; Max Vehicle Length 25 (1), 40 (33), 50-90 (7)) + rec.gov description ('44 standard sites suitable for tents, trailers and RVs') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Cow Creek South CG '# of sites / max site length' '32/30''), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water. Bear-proof food lockers at every site.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234596 ('Vault toilets are provided.'; notices 'No drinking water available at this campground', 'Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/cow-creek-south-campground ('Vault toilets are provided.'; Water 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('These are estimated opening dates'; Cow Creek South CG Season '5/20-10/2'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Every site is reservable; booking closes 3 days before arrival and no reservations are taken after October 1. A site must be occupied by 11 a.m. the day after arrival or it is released. 14 days within 30.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234596 (reservationCutOff 3; minWeekendStay/minHolidayWeekendStay 0 'soft' = no rule; notice 'Reserved Sites will be held until check out time (ELEVEN) the day following your arrival date') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 05-20 to 10-01) + catalog (43 of 43 reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (Cow Creek South 'R'; '*Reservations will no longer be accepted after October 1st') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/camping-cabins ('Unless otherwise noted, maximum stay is 14 days within a 30-day period'), read 2026-10-28

note: Dillon RD (White River NF), on the northeast shore of Green Mountain Reservoir off CO-9 near mile marker 124; open sage bench with the sites strung along the shoreline bluff. Site access is difficult when the road is wet. Motorboats launch at Heeney Marina after an ANS inspection. --Claude
summary: rec.gov API + rates + catalog + FS page + WRNF 2026 table: confirmed $21 (rec.gov 2026/2027; FS says $23), 43 sites, electric 0, reservable on recreation.gov. flags: Fee conflict: recreation.gov $21 (2026 and 2027) vs the WRNF 2026 table $23. Recorded $21 (rec.gov current year).
Count conflict: rec.gov catalog 43 sites (all reservable), rec.gov description 44, WRNF 2026 table 32. Kept 43.

Max length conflict: WRNF 2026 table max site length 30 ft; catalog 25 ft (1), 40 ft (33), 50-90 ft (7). Set 30 from the FS table, as done for Prospector; the stored 90 was a single catalog site. EKKO's 23 ft fits either way.

Restrooms conflict: rec.gov and the FS page's facilities text both say 'Vault toilets are provided', but the FS page's amenity block says 'Restrooms are not available at this site'. Recorded vault_toilets true from the explicit sentence.

Waterfront (stored lakeview): upgrade LEAD. On Esri imagery (taken at a low reservoir level) the sites are strung along the edge of the sage bench directly above the shoreline, on open ground with no trees between, roughly 20-40 m from the vegetation line that marks the high-water edge; a wide exposed drawdown beach lies below. rec.gov/FS: 'located on the northeast shore'. Needs the gate against Green Mountain Reservoir's full-pool elevation (heavily drawn down late season).

Pin: stored 39.87944,-106.27722 is the FS GPS point at the entrance off CO-9, 762 m NE of the centroid of the 43 site points (39.87685,-106.28548). Re-pin to about 39.87685,-106.28548 (or onto the south shore loop, e.g. 39.8755,-106.2830).
